# momentum-universe — LLM integration guide

This repository is a point-in-time momentum + swing research system for
Indian equities (NSE). It answers the PURELY TECHNICAL questions — what to
buy, how much, suggested stops, and rotation horizons — from ~13 years of
vendored data, credential-free. It deliberately models NO fundamentals,
shareholding, news, or valuations. That diligence layer is YOUR job as the
LLM: take the system's picks, research each ticker with your own tools
(fundamentals APIs, web search, filings), and confirm or veto.

## One-time machine setup

    git clone <repo-url> momentum-universe
    cd momentum-universe
    ./start.sh        # bootstraps .venv, installs deps, builds the local DuckDB
                      # (exit the interactive menu once it loads — setup is done)

## MCP server

Read-only stdio server exposing the allocation stack:

    .venv/bin/python -m fortress.mcp_server

The server resolves all paths from its own location — the client's working
directory does not matter.

### Claude Code

The repo ships a project-scoped `.mcp.json`; opening Claude Code inside the
repo detects the "momentum-universe" server automatically (approve when
prompted). To register it globally (usable from any directory):

    claude mcp add momentum-universe --scope user -- \
      /ABS/PATH/TO/momentum-universe/.venv/bin/python -m fortress.mcp_server

### Codex

Append to `~/.codex/config.toml`:

    [mcp_servers.momentum_universe]
    command = "/ABS/PATH/TO/momentum-universe/.venv/bin/python"
    args = ["-m", "fortress.mcp_server"]

### Any other MCP client (generic stdio config)

    command: /ABS/PATH/TO/momentum-universe/.venv/bin/python
    args:    ["-m", "fortress.mcp_server"]

## Tools

- swing_allocation_plan(capital=500000, hb_slots=3, rsi_slots=2, as_of?)
  Swing sleeve: partitions capital into equal slots across the two adopted
  scanners (high_base_52w breakouts x3, rsi2_pullback mean-reversion x2 —
  the validated best split). Returns per-slot ticker, quantity, rupee
  allocation, suggested stop, and forced-rotation horizon in trading days.
- fresh_allocation(momentum_capital=0, swing_capital=0, climbers_capital=0,
    momentum_top_n?, hb_slots=3, rsi_slots=2, climbers_top_n=8)
  Stateless "here is Rs X, what do I buy?" — a fresh combined buy plan for the
  entered amounts, NO existing holdings. Splits across three sleeves (any 0 to
  skip): momentum (active strategy), swing (3+2 partition), and climbers — the
  validated SATELLITE accumulation-climbers strategy (rank-velocity 1-500 band,
  still basing, ~5 concentrated names, quarterly rotation, higher-risk alpha).
  Returns per-stock qty/value/stop/rotation, overlap flags across all sleeves,
  ADV fill-risk per slot, and a regime hint. Diligence each climber's catalyst.
- momentum_scan(top_n=20)
  Top-N ranked momentum stocks under the active strategy (default
  regime_switched_momentum) with score, 52w-high proximity, returns,
  volatility, turnover. These tend to be names that have ALREADY run.
- emerging_scan(top_n=15)
  The pre-run complement: stocks EARLY in a momentum move. Combines a
  point-in-time LIQUIDITY-RANK climb (turnover rank ~2y ago -> now) with
  early price momentum (above 200SMA, breaking toward 52w high, 12-month
  return capped so already-parabolic names are excluded). Returns each
  stock's rank trajectory, 3/6/12m returns, proximity, acceleration,
  volatility, turnover. Purely technical — diligence each pick (below).
- rank_velocity(lookback_months=6, top_n=25, rank_lo=251, rank_hi=2000,
    min_turnover_cr=10.0, min_climb=150, exclude_ipos=True, max_12m_return=None,
    max_6m_return=None, require_above_200sma=False, exclude_recent_actions=False,
    max_drawdown=None)
  (rank_lo/rank_hi = current-rank band — a cap tier's band or a custom range
  like 1000-1500; default 251-2000 = deep tail. Each row carries off_high_pct
  = % below the 52-week high, so a faded name is visible. ACCUMULATION/early
  preset — rank-climb is coincident/lagging, so to catch names STILL BASING
  (money ahead) set require_above_200sma=True + a low max_6m_return like 30 +
  max_12m_return like 60. Validated: raw climbers are 100% real companies but
  mostly LATE; this preset isolates the genuine-early subset.)
  RESEARCH radar for EARLY MULTIBAGGERS (not a buy list): deep-tail stocks
  climbing the turnover rank FASTEST (fast climbers + new entrants, to rank
  2000), enriched with PRICE momentum. Turnover-rank climb is a LIQUIDITY
  signal (turnover = price x volume), so each row also carries 6m/12m price
  return + 200SMA — so you can tell a genuine price markup from a liquidity
  spike with flat price. exclude_ipos drops recent listings (float onboarding,
  not a markup); max_12m_return drops already-parabolic names (momentum
  behind). Sweet spot: climbing + above 200SMA + moving but not parabolic
  (runway ahead). Investigate the catalyst per name (news / fundamentals /
  StockEdge). Two "is the climb REAL?" tells guard against mechanical liquidity:
  recent_action flags a split/bonus in the climb window (float multiplied, not
  organic — exclude_recent_actions drops them), and max_dd_6m is the worst
  6-month drawdown (deep = crash-and-recover round-trip, not a base — max_drawdown
  e.g. -35 drops them). Returns rank then-vs-now, velocity, is_ipo, recent_action,
  max_dd_6m, returns, tier, sector.
- momentum_allocation(capital, top_n?, holdings?)
  Momentum sleeve: target portfolio (weights, quantities) and buy/sell
  orders, optionally diffed against current holdings {symbol: qty}.
- market_state()
  Current regime (BULLISH/NORMAL/CAUTION/DEFENSIVE), VIX, NIFTY 52-week
  position, stress score, target equity/gold/cash split.
- universe_lookup(symbol, on_date?)
  Point-in-time turnover rank and whether the symbol is inside the
  strategies' scan band (ranks 201-600 of the v2 momentum-grade universe).
- stock_snapshot(symbol)
  Per-ticker technical context: 1/3/6/12-month returns, 200SMA status,
  52w-high proximity, ATR(14), 20-day average turnover.

## Suggested diligence workflow

1. `market_state()` — know the regime before judging picks.
2. Get the technical picks:
   - `momentum_scan` — established-momentum leaders (often already run).
   - `emerging_scan` — the pre-run complement (rank climbing + early momentum).
   - `swing_allocation_plan` / `momentum_allocation` — sized deployment plans.
3. Per ticker: `stock_snapshot` + `universe_lookup` for technical context,
   then YOUR research — earnings quality, promoter pledges/shareholding
   changes, pending corporate actions, regulatory news, valuation sanity.
4. Report confirm/veto per pick with reasons; never resize positions beyond
   the plan's quantities — sizing and stops are the system's domain.

### Auto-diligence pattern (emerging_scan -> per-pick diligence)

An LLM client (Claude Code / Codex) can chain this into a repeatable
"find-and-vet" pass:

  a. Call `emerging_scan(top_n=N)` to get the ranked early-momentum shortlist.
  b. For EACH returned ticker, run a full 12-point diligence — business & moat,
     momentum catalyst, earnings quality & GROWTH durability, balance sheet,
     cash flow (OCF vs PAT), valuation-vs-growth (is there still ROOM?),
     shareholding (promoter trend / PLEDGE / FII-DII-MF flows), insider/deals,
     news/rumors/management actions, red flags / bear thesis, corporate
     calendar, verdict — using your fundamental data sources (e.g. a StockEdge
     MCP: search the company by NAME, then pull shareholding, results/news,
     P&L/ratios; plus web search for rumors and management actions).
     [StockEdge MCP token expired? Refresh it with the browser-console helper
      scripts/stockedge-token-extract.js — steps are in the file header.]
  c. Because "emerging" catches low-quality micro-cap pops as well as genuine
     early growers, weight CASH-FLOW QUALITY and PLEDGE heavily — they are the
     sharpest separators. Rank picks by conviction and surface every red flag.

  Tip: dispatch one diligence sub-agent per ticker in parallel so the briefs
  come back concurrently, then synthesize a ranked comparison.

## Caveats for agents

- All tools are read-only and run on vendored data (refreshed via CLI
  menu 1, "Universe update"); prices are end-of-day, not live.
- Data freshness: check the `as_of` field in every response.
- Run at most ONE process against the local DuckDB at a time (single-writer
  lock) — don't call tools while a backtest or universe update is running.
- Backtests are intentionally NOT exposed as tools (minutes-long); run them
  from the CLI (menu 4) or `fortress.actions.run_backtest` instead.
- Educational/research use only — not financial advice. See DISCLAIMER.md.
